title: terrain.chunk_mutated
description: M8A § Semantic terrain event protocol. Emitted on every chunk-level mutation (dig / blast / fill / settle / stamp / door_toggle / hazard_burn) with the post-state checksum that downstream clients use to verify their predicted chunk state. Replaces CCCP-style raw bitmap deltas.

cause.description: What kind of mutation occurred. Replay tooling routes by cause.

chunk_coords.description: (cx, cy) — the chunk index in M3's chunked-terrain indexing.

bbox.description: (x, y, w, h) — dirty-rect within the chunk.

delta_materials.description: Per-pixel material changes. Each entry carries local-to-chunk coords + old + new material id.

post_state_checksum.description: blake3 hex of the chunk's material grid AFTER the mutation. Downstream clients verify their predicted state matches.

cause_event_id.description: Forward link to the higher-level event (e.g., explosion, weapon fire) that caused the mutation.
